business_problem: MAPFRE needed to untangle point-to-point legacy integrations, duplicated data spread across 200-plus systems, and fragmented customer, policy, and claims records while lowering maintenance cost and improving governance.
solution_summary: MAPFRE reworked its insurance data estate from an application-centric landscape into a platform ecosystem organized around nine business domains and two shared platforms. In the new design, MongoDB Atlas on AWS stores Golden Records that act as the authoritative profile for customers, policies, and claims. Legacy COBOL-based cores, application servers, and relational databases remain in place for transactional processing, but MAPFRE decouples read and query workloads from those systems through change-data-capture and an event-driven pipeline built with Kafka and Flink. Those streams continuously project updates into Atlas, where flexible document storage and specialized query models support high-volume reads without schema fragmentation. Reusable archetypes from MAPFRE's internal engineering platform standardize deployment, governance, and lifecycle ownership across domains, giving teams a scalable hybrid foundation for consistent data access.

solution_components.name: MongoDB Atlas
solution_components.role: Stores MAPFRE's Golden Records and provides the scalable query layer for customer, policy, and claims entities.

solution_components.name: Kafka
solution_components.role: Carries event streams from legacy on-premises cores into the Golden Record pipeline in real time.

solution_components.name: Flink
solution_components.role: Processes CDC-driven streams before they are persisted as Golden Records in MongoDB Atlas.

data_flow: Legacy on-premises core systems emit change-data-capture events that Kafka and Flink stream into Golden Record documents in MongoDB Atlas on AWS; functional platforms then query those records instead of hitting core transactional systems directly, while reusable archetypes standardize rollout across domains.
business_outcome: MAPFRE established a single source of truth for business entities, improved operational efficiency and data governance, scaled high-volume queries without stressing core systems, and sped up delivery of customer-facing innovation.
metrics: "nine functional business domains supported by two technical platforms for engineering and integration"
architecture_clues: The Golden Record platform runs as a hybrid on-premises and cloud architecture.

MAPFRE industrialized rollout with reusable archetypes and standard infrastructure from its internal engineering platform.
